entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Jamaica became Britain's most profitable sugar colony. Over 600,000 enslaved Africans were imported during the 18th century alone, working under horrific conditions on over 700 sugar estates. The planter class — known as the plantocracy — wielded immense political power in London.
